title: dont split phone ssn card
rule: Do not split phone, SSN, or credit-card numbers into separate fields. One input; segmented fields force meaningless labels for AT. Distinct from GOV.UK three-field dates.
pass_when: Phone, SSN, and card number are each one field.
fail_when: Those numbers are split across multiple fields.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Memorable date three fields as this row; input-mask (skipped as NN/g).
